# Fanfarr v0.5.30

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## One Theme source card, plus a director filter

The item page showed three cards across -- Plex, ThemerrDB, your pick -- and
the last two were mostly air. One "Theme source" card holds both now: the
pick first, because it wins, ThemerrDB's suggestion under a divider. The
grid drops to two columns to match.

Directors ride along from Plex the way studios and collections already do:
parsed from the Director tags, synced, and a library filter with the same
shape -- dropdown, clickable links from the item's Plex card, and a
`?director=` URL that survives sorting. Usually one on a film, usually none
on a show, and then the row reads a dash.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
